info.name: HRM Employee Mobile API (v1)
info.description: Employee mobile app API. Import the environment too, set email and password, then run "Login" first: it saves the token for every other request. Full documentation: README.md in the same folder.

request.description: Sign in with e-mail and password. Saves the token to the environment.

urlencoded.description: Optional: shown as the token name

response.name: Logged in
Wrong password
Invalid e-mail
Login disabled by HR
Logged out

request.description: The signed-in employee: personal and job details, emergency contacts, today's shift.

response.name: Profile

response.name: Not theirs

request.description: Issued (approved / paid) payslips, newest first. Saves the first id as payslip_id.

response.name: Payslips

request.description: Earnings, deductions, employer contributions, attendance and net pay.

response.name: Payslip
Not issued / not theirs

request.description: The payslip PDF, the same as the website. In Postman use "Send and Download".
Clocked in? On a break? Today's sessions and breaks, and whether photo / location are required.

response.name: Clocked in, on a break
Not clocked in

request.description: Clock in with photo and location (multipart/form-data). Pick an image file for "photo".

formdata.description: Camera image (jpg/png/webp, max 2 MB). Required when /attendance/today says requirements.photo = mandatory.
Alternative to photo: the image as base64

response.name: Clocked in
Already clocked in

request.description: Start a lunch / tea / other break. Recorded only: worked hours are not reduced.

response.name: Break started
A break is already running
Not clocked in
Break ended
No break running

request.description: Clock out with photo and location (multipart/form-data). Ends a running break too.

formdata.description: Camera image (jpg/png/webp, max 2 MB). Required when /attendance/today says requirements.photo = mandatory.
Alternative to photo: the image as base64

response.name: Clocked out
Not clocked in

request.description: Every day of the month as payroll counts it: status, punches, late, leave, holiday, breaks, plus month totals.
